BLOOM CYCLE 2.0 — 10,000-SENTENCE REACT PRODUCT MASTER PROMPT
Read this entire specification as an implementation brief for the existing Bloom application.
Use the supplied Cycle screenshots as the visual baseline and improve the product substantially rather than producing a generic redesign.
Keep the existing React stack unless a narrowly justified technical change is required.
Use real data, real calculations, and real application behavior.
Never fabricate health information, Cycle history, predictions, accuracy, or AI context.
Treat estimated reproductive-health timing as uncertain where appropriate.
Keep sensitive Cycle information private.
Make the final experience visually sophisticated, useful, responsive, accessible, performant, and production-ready.
